title: Six-class secp256k1 rho at 126.3029: table-conditional work meter replaces the Markov allowance (p0=0.3900003)

claims.statement: For a uniform full-production secp256k1 input, the classical cold six-class parallel Pollard-rho attack of upstream-proof.md (construction, kernels, prices, store, hard rows and kappa=1.01 H1 calibration unchanged from submission 412b63f7) halts on every run with total work at most 2^126.3029 target-group-operation equivalents (classical-group-work-v2, C=1000) and succeeds with probability at least 0.3900000972 under heuristics H1, H2 (per-table uniform labels at fresh arrivals) and H3 (E[collisions] <= 2^14) of proof.md section 3.1. Only the meter allowance changes: the Markov reserve ceil(E/0.003830) is replaced by a table-conditional allowance (2x the doubling mean and 8x the traversal-cycle mean, bounded for every table by Kolmogorov's maximal inequality over i.i.d. trail label tapes, tails 2^-54.87 and 2^-54.06; a retrace row for up to 2^44 collisions; starts and small charges at 2^30 times expectation). Early-halt probability < 2.8e-9, so p0 = 0.3900003. Exact ledger: phase 1 2^126.3027557, hard 2^107.1555015, allowance 2^112.5722739, W_ledger 2^126.3028643 < 2^126.3029; certificate.py checks this exactly, including W^10000 < 1000^10000*2^1263029 and W^10000 > 1000^10000*2^1263028. h2_census.py gives toy evidence for H2 and H3. This revises rejected submission 0cc8702b. No prior acceptance, verdict or score is a premise; dependencies 412b63f7 and 0cc8702b are declared. Analytic heuristic bound, not a practical break.

experiments.purpose: Part A: production secp256k1 checks of the walk identities and truncated canonical-index rule; Part B: a scaled sequential toy pipeline on configured subgroups of y^2=x^3+7 with an unreduced subgroup-order check, a T_c census, node routing, and a long-trail trap test; kernels: limb-for-limb Python ports of the field kernels checked against big integers and affine secp256k1, instruction counts parsed from the shipped AArch64 assembly, the shipped loops executed by an interpreter, and the work-meter ledger recomputed from the prices and rows of proof.md section 5. The toy run does not meter production instructions or implement 2^20 concurrent walks. With "h2": the H2/H3 toy census of h2_census.py (proof.md section 4): ANOVA over fresh tables of strict-trail doubling and traversal counts, and the inter-trail collision count K, run after the other parts and stopped by T0+until seconds.
